name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceMultipleRewardSingleEnterActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user begins a single-app experience reward offer. It shows the task's entry prompt and the reward amount before the experience starts.
disableEffect: The single-app reward task cannot start, and its related ad rewards will no longer be granted.
